envelope.text: The copy is re-read at each call and kept

why: issue 2056 (2026-10-25), measured on Nav2's `nav2_velocity_smoother` @jazzy (phase-488 node 2) and over Autoware 0.45.1 (183 files name `std::vector<rclcpp::Parameter>`). OVERRIDDEN, declined -> divergence/adopt-bounded. The recorded reason, "no allocator", is true of a freestanding build and false of the hosted (`NROS_CPP_STD`) build ported code uses. A view of the node, in the node-interface handle shape issue 2015 gave the other slices: `SharedPtr` is the view itself and `->` reaches it, with `has_parameter`, `declare_parameter` (a descriptor message included) and `get_parameter`, each forwarding to the node. Nav2's `nav2_util::declare_or_get_parameter` takes one. `get_parameter_overrides()` (issue 2057, 2026-10-26) lists the `-p` / `--params-file` overrides that apply to the node, typed from their text as an undeclared parameter's would be. It returns a reference to one copy per node, as upstream's does, so Nav2's `get_parameter_overrides().find(n) == get_parameter_overrides().end()` compares iterators of one map. THE BOUND: the copy is re-read at each call and kept when nothing changed, so a reference stays valid only until the overrides change, where upstream's never change after the node is constructed. Previous text: see the node stage's `cpp:Node::get_node_base_interface` -- rclcpp's ~10 `node_interfaces::Node*Interface` slices exist so a component can be handed the part it needs; our components are declared, not constructed with an injected node (RFC-0044).
